key.name: opencode-go-key
key.description: Leave empty to auto-read ~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json (opencode-go key). Get a key at https://opencode.ai/auth after subscribing to Go.

key.name: codex-access-token
key.description: OAuth access token from ~/.codex/auth.json (created by `codex login`). Leave empty to auto-read the file. Never share this token.

key.name: codex-account-id
key.description: Account ID from ~/.codex/auth.json alongside the access token. Leave empty to auto-read the file.

key.name: codex-auth-path
key.description: Leave empty for auto-detect: $CODEX_HOME/auth.json, then ~/.codex/auth.json. Used only when the token fields above are empty.

key.name: refresh-minutes
key.description: How often to poll usage endpoints, in minutes.

key.name: show-go
key.description: Show OpenCode Go usage in the top bar label.

key.name: show-codex
key.description: Show Codex subscription usage in the top bar label.
